tool.name: ultra-rare-art-archive
tool.description: The world's most comprehensive digital archive of rare artworks, featuring exclusive access to masterpieces like 'Corridor in the Asylum'. Provides unparalleled detail including artist's notes, historical context, exhibition history, valuation data, and ultra-high-resolution images. This premium service requires authentication for full functionality.
